claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_trigger family for ClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Disciple of Life is always-on: it fires automatically whenever the cleric casts a healing spell with a spell slot. It has no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires all three. A new family — 'passive_trigger' or 'passive_modifier' — is needed for class features that are unconditionally active and fire on an external triggering condition rather than a player-initiated activation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: augment_spell_heal effect type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature adds a flat HP bonus (2 + slot_level) to healing done by any spell the cleric casts with a spell slot. This is not modeled by HealHpEffect (which makes the feature itself the source of healing, like Second Wind or Divine Spark) or by any other ClassFeatureEffect variant. A new variant — 'augment_spell_heal' — is needed to express 'add X HP to the healing of a spell you cast with a slot'. The scaling shape (2 + slot_level) is already representable as LinearPerLevel<number> with axis='slot', base=2, perLevel=1, startingAtLevel=1.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The additional Hit Points equal 2 plus the spell slot's level.
